messages:
Morgan: heads up — there's a coverage gap for the upcoming holiday weekend (sat 02:00–10:00 UTC). Primary is out, secondary is partial overlap. I need a volunteer to be primary for the 02:00–06:00 UTC block and someone to shadow 06:00–10:00 UTC. short notice, i know :grimacing:

Ben: i can take 02:00–06:00 UTC if no one else has better promises. i'm EST but awake for that window. what’s the expected load? any ongoing incidents to be aware of?

Morgan: thanks Ben. load looks normal right now — no active incidents. just want coverage in case we get throughput regressions during the scheduled infra maintenance. oncall runbook is here: https://play.redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-coverage (see section "holiday ops"), and escalation matrix: https://play.redwood.internal/policy/escalation.

Carla: i can do the 06:00–10:00 UTC shadow; will be available to take over if anything needs longer-lived attention. quick Q: what's the step to failover to dedicated pool?

Morgan: @Carla steps in runbook — short snippet:
```
# failover to dedicated pool
1) confirm degraded pods: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide
2) trigger routing override: infractl route set --pool dedicated --duration 30m --reason "holiday failover"
3) monitor token latency on console (route: /model/*)
```
if you want, i can post the exact infractl command later.

Priya: FYI i’ll be on-call remotely but in a meeting 03:00–04:00 UTC. i can still ack/force-failover but not deep debug. if Ben needs me to take over for a page, call me.

Ben: acked. noted Priya's meeting. i'll escalate to Priya if multiple pages show up. can you drop the infractl command here Morgan?

DevOpsBot: Incident policy reminder: when an alert fires for "inference-high-latency" tag the primary should ack within 5m and follow runbook "latency-inference". Pager duty link: https://pd.redwood.com/incidents

oncall-bot: scheduled handoff reminder set for 2026-04-04T01:50:00Z.

Morgan: infractl command to trigger routing override (test this from jumpbox):
```
infractl route set --pool dedicated --duration 30m --reason "holiday failover" --confirm
```
Also, quick checklist for the primary:
- ack page in PD and post status here
- capture initial latency/throughput numbers (console snapshot)
- attempt soft recovery (restart affected service)
- trigger dedicated pool failover if soft recovery fails after 10m
- notify customers via status page if >30m

Carla: copied. one more ask — who is the escalation contact for legal / security for the weekend? last time we ended up paging secops manually.

Morgan: escalation: first secops contact is Priya, second is Legal Pager (legal-team@pager.redwood). but hopefully not needed.

Ben: taking notes. i'll join the handoff at 01:50 UTC if someone posts a short "handing off to Ben" message. also leaving a small wrapper script i'll run on takeover:
```bash
# quick health check
curl -sS https://console.redwood.internal/health | jq .inference
# restart transient worker
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/worker-transient
```

Priya: thanks everyone — i’ll be reachable by phone (dm me for number). if anything escalates beyond infra, i'll jump in. good luck and try to get some sleep before :wave:

Morgan: amazing — summary: Ben primary 02:00–06:00 UTC, Carla shadow 06:00–10:00 UTC, Priya available for escalation, Morgan on-call oversight and can help with infractl. i'll post a short handoff message before 01:50 UTC to lock it in. tagging the oncall reminders and runbook links again. :thumbsup:
